{{Quote|You all right, pera?''"<br />"''Yes, my fi.|Han Solo and Pera|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>}}
"'''Pera'''" was a [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]] expression used to address clergymen of the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]]. It meant "father," and was used to address the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Pera|priest]] of [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].
